card.title: Don’t Be Difficult
card.instruction: Treat every request, correction, or small inconvenience as a warning that you are becoming too much trouble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could I get a lift? Only if it isn't trouble.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll move my coat off the passenger seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't move it for me. I'll sit in the back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's full of shopping. Hold the coat; I'll turn the heating down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't change it. I'll keep the coat on my lap. If I get hot, I can get out and walk the rest.
